description_en: Apply for a public endpoint for an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于为RDS实例申请外网连接地址
kebab_example: aliyun rds allocate-instance-public-connection --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --connection-string-prefix test1234 --port 3306 --babelfish-port 1433 --general-group-name rgc-bp1tkv80000 --pg-bouncer-port 6432 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AllocateInstancePublicConnection

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The prefix of the public endpoint. A valid public endpoint is in the following format: `Prefix.Database engine.rds.aliyuncs.com`. Example: `test1234.mysql.rds.aliyuncs.com`.

The value can be 5 to 40 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-). The value cannot contain any of the following characters: ~ ! # % ^ & * = + | {} ; : ' " , <> / ?
parameters.help_zh:
外网连接地址的前缀。完整外网连接地址为：`前缀.引擎名.rds.aliyuncs.com`。例如`test1234.mysql.rds.aliyuncs.com`。

长度5\~40，不能包含汉字和非法字符（\~!#%^&*=+|{};:'",<>/?），建议由字母、数字、短横线（-）组成
parameters.name: connection_string_prefix

parameters.help_en: The public port of the instance. Valid values: 1000 to 5999
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en:
The Tabular Data Stream (TDS) port of the instance for which Babelfish is enabled.

This parameter applies only to ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances. For more information about Babelfish for ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428613.html
parameters.help_zh:
Babelfish for RDS PostgreSQL TDS端口号。
该参数仅适用于RDS PostgreSQL实例，Babelfish for RDS PostgreSQL的更多介绍，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428613.html
parameters.name: babelfish_port

parameters.help_en: The name of the dedicated cluster to which the instance belongs. This parameter is available only when the instance is created in an ApsaraDB MyBase cluster that runs MySQL on Standard Edition
parameters.help_zh: 专属集群MySQL通用版实例所属的组名
parameters.name: general_group_name

parameters.help_en:
The PgBouncer port.

This parameter is available only for instances that run PostgreSQL
parameters.help_zh:
PgBouncer端口。
该参数仅支持PostgreSQL实例
parameters.name: pg_bouncer_port

ConnectionString.description_en: The endpoint that is used to connect to the database instance
